chunks: Ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Abū Jamīlah, from Abān ibn Taghlib, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
For the lower lip, the compensation is six thousand, and for the upper one, four thousand, because the lower lip holds water.

key_terms.أَرْبَعَةُ آلَافٍ: four thousand, the amount of compensation mentioned for the upper lip
key_terms.الشَّفَةِ السُّفْلَى: the lower lip, for which the higher compensation is assigned
key_terms.الْعُلْيَا: the upper lip, for which a lesser compensation is assigned
key_terms.تُمْسِكُ الْمَاءَ: holds water, the stated reason for the lower lip’s greater compensation
key_terms.سِتَّةُ آلَافٍ: six thousand, the amount of compensation mentioned for the lower lip

ai.seo_question: What is the blood money compensation for the lower and upper lips in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on blood money compensation for injury to the lips, assigning a greater amount to the lower lip than the upper lip. The reason given is functional: the lower lip has a greater role in holding water, which affects the valuation in juridical assessment.
